name: kortex-memory
description: Persistent, governed memory for Claude Code. Remember decisions once; recall them in every future session, across every tool on the team.

mcp_url.title: Kortex MCP endpoint
mcp_url.description: The SSE endpoint of your Kortex MCP server, e.g. https://kortex.example.com:8765/sse. For a local `make dev` stack this is http://localhost:8765/sse.

api_key.title: Kortex API key
api_key.description: A kx_* key from `kortex key create`. Scoped to one org, so it decides which memories this machine can read and write.
